description: Dependency updates for the music-management monorepo. Every ecosystem in here (pip, npm, Gradle, Dockerfile) is picked up automatically; the rules below only decide how the updates are grouped and how eagerly they are merged.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates of the Python runtime stack move together: they are covered by the unit suite and reviewing them one by one is noise.
A major of fastapi/pydantic/sqlalchemy is a migration, not an update. Keep those separate so they get their own review.
yt-dlp ships breaking extractor fixes as ordinary releases; being behind on it is what actually breaks downloading. Merge automatically once the pipeline is green.
Dev tooling is not shipped to production; an upgrade can only turn the pipeline red, never break a user.
Frontend dev dependencies move fast and are covered by lint + typecheck + vitest.
Base image bumps rebuild every service image, so they are reviewed by hand.
Vendored upstream fork; its dependencies are managed by that project, not here.
